body:
OBSERVED 2026-08-09, while verifying a Discord report from user Aoife (2026-07-16).

`frontend/src/pages/MagicShelfView.tsx:78-80` computes:

    const canKobo = Boolean(
      data.is_owner && me?.features?.kobo_sync && me?.features?.kobo_sync_magic_shelves,
    );

and the control renders as `{canKobo && (<button …>Enable Kobo sync</button>)}`
(~line 126) with **no else branch**. When the admin-level
`config_kobo_sync_magic_shelves` is off, the button is simply absent and the user
is given no reason.

Classic does the opposite and does it correctly: `cps/templates/magic_shelf_edit.html:432`
renders the checkbox **disabled** and pairs it with an explanation at line 436 —
"Turn on 'Sync Magic Shelves to Kobo' in CWA Settings first — until then this
checkbox has no effect and the shelf won't reach your Kobo."

So the SPA is strictly less discoverable than the surface it replaces. The
in-code comment defends hiding it ("rather than let it store inert intent"),
which is right about not persisting a no-op mark but wrong about the remedy:
disabled-with-reason achieves the same thing and tells the user what to do.

Compounding it, `config_kobo_sync_magic_shelves` is only settable in the classic
CWA Settings page — the SPA has no CWA-settings surface at all. An admin working
only in the new UI therefore cannot enable the prerequisite AND receives no hint
that a prerequisite exists.

WHY THIS MATTERS BEYOND THE CONTROL: this is the failure shape behind the
feedback-form defection reasons (missing a feature 34, something broken 22, vs
prefer-the-classic-look 10). Aoife's message is a worked example — she asked
"is this a bug or am I missing a step?", could not tell which, and apologised.
A hidden control converts a configuration state into an apparent bug.

FIX: render the toggle disabled with the classic explanation when
`kobo_sync_magic_shelves` is false, rather than omitting it. Cross-reference the
SPA CWA-settings gap (see notes/SPA-ROOT-CUTOVER-DESIGN.md §1.4, admin-blocking).

Reported-adjacent: Discord user Aoife, 2026-07-16. Umbrella: #867.
title: New UI hides the smart-shelf Kobo toggle instead of explaining why it is unavailable
